resources.string: Switch back to your other keyboard
Talk in English, Urdu or both. Tap the floating mic in any app, and Murmur types what you said into the box you\'re in. It\'s free with a Gemini key.
Switch to it when you want to talk: tap the keyboard button at the bottom of your screen, or the globe key.
Anthropic API key (paid API credits; a Claude subscription doesn\'t cover it)
Names, brands and jargon it should always spell right, one per line
Go back to my normal keyboard after each dictation
Tap here, switch to Murmur, and talk

Your keys and settings stay on this phone. Your audio goes only to the service you picked (Gemini by default). On Gemini\'s free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products. Nothing else is sent anywhere.

Shows a small mic button while you type in any app. Tap it and talk, and Murmur types what you said into that text box. Murmur only reads which text box is focused, so it knows where to show the bubble and put your words. Your audio goes only to the speech service you chose in Murmur.
Free requests used up for today: %1$s. Murmur is using other Gemini models in the meantime. They come back at %2$s.
In Accessibility, open Murmur mic bubble and turn it on. If Android says it\'s a restricted setting, tap App info, then ⋮ (top right), then Allow restricted settings, and try again.
If you\'d rather not use the bubble, switch to the Murmur keyboard when you want to talk.
Show the mic bubble even when I\'m not typing
Share a recording to Murmur from another app, such as Voice Recorder or WhatsApp.
Add your API key in Murmur first (a free Gemini key works), then share the recording again.
Put the phone on the table and tap Record. It keeps listening with the screen off, and the notes are ready about a minute after you stop.
Murmur writes it down as you go. You can lock the phone.
Your meetings show up here. You can also share a recording to Murmur, from Voice Recorder or WhatsApp.
Finish setting up: add your free Gemini key. Tap here.
Finish setting up: allow the microphone. Tap here.
Meetings need your free Gemini key. Add it in Settings.
Murmur needs the microphone to record. Allow it in Murmur.
Android didn\'t let Murmur use the microphone. Open Murmur and tap Record there.
Murmur was closed before this was finished. Everything recorded is kept; tap Continue.
Recording. Each few minutes are written down as you go.
This meeting stopped before it was finished.
Here is the transcript of a meeting. Write clear notes: a short summary, the key points, decisions, and action items with who does what.
Its recording, transcript and notes are deleted from this phone.
Everything you\'ve dictated, kept on this phone. Tap to copy, hold to delete.
Nothing yet. Your dictations show up here.
Start and stop a meeting recording in one tap.
Murmur remembers this for this app. Tap a style.
No internet, so your phone\'s own recognizer wrote this (English only, not cleaned up).
Today Gemini answered %1$d free requests (%2$s). The free allowance resets at %3$s.
No Gemini requests yet today. The free allowance resets at %1$s.
Add your own styles, one per line: a name, a colon, then what it should do. They show up next to Clean, Message, Email and Notes. Hold the mic bubble to pick the style for the app you\'re in.
LinkedIn: Write it as a LinkedIn post, warm and professional\nClient email: Polite, clear email to a client, no slang
Murmur uses Message in chat apps, Email in mail apps and Notes in notes apps, until you pick something else there.
With no internet, let the phone\'s own recognizer write English dictation
